title: Occurrence Vector Choice
body_html:
Occurrence Vector Choice

Given nonzero occurrence of a refined \(K\)-type in the oscillator representation, there are \(x''\in B(G')\) and \(w\in B_{x,x'',s}\) such that the \(K\)-type occurs in the orbit subspace \(S(B_{x,x'',0})_w\), and \[ M(w) \] matches the semisimple datum modulo the top-depth source lattice and is block diagonal with respect to the highest-depth block.
proof_html: Appendix B decomposes \(G_{x,r+}\)-fixed vectors as a sum over target building points, so some \(x''\) contributes to the desired \(K\)-type projection. The support decomposition of the generalized lattice model gives \(w\). The source character forces \(M(w)\) into the required coset. Kim-Murnaghan conjugacy for good elements then moves the moment value into the centralizer block form without killing the occurrence.
